papers.title: Enhanced Osseointegration of Hierarchically Structured Ti Implant with Electrically Bioactive SnO
papers.abstract: The poor osseointegration of Ti implant significantly compromise its application in load-bearing bone repair and replacement. Electrically bioactive coating inspirited from heterojunction on Ti implant can benefit osseointegration but cannot avoid the stress shielding effect between bone and implant. To resolve this conflict, hierarchically structured Ti implant with electrically bioactive SnO2-TiO2 bilayered surface has been developed to enhance osseointegration. Benefiting from the electric cue offered by the built-in electrical field of SnO2-TiO2 heterojunction and the topographic cue provided by the hierarchical surface structure to bone regeneration, the osteoblastic function of basic multicellular units around the implant is significantly improved. Because the individual TiO2 or SnO2 coating with uniform surface exhibits no electrical bioactivity, the effects of electric and topographic cues to osseointegration have been decoupled via the analysis of in vivo performance for the placed Ti implant with different surfaces. The developed Ti implant shows significantly improved osseointegration with excellent bone-implant contact, improved mineralization of extracellular matrix, and increased push-out force. These results suggest that the synergistic strategy of combing electrical bioactivity with hierarchical surface structure provides a new platform for developing advanced endosseous implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注植入物表面涂层对骨整合的影响，未涉及髋关节假体应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone remodeling in Gruen zones; no FEA or biomechanical modeling of hip implant.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高钛植入体的骨整合性能，同时避免应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 制备具有SnO2-TiO2异质结电活性涂层和分级表面结构的钛植入体。
summary_zh.result: 电活性和拓扑结构协同促进骨整合，提高骨-植入体接触和推出力。
summary_zh.validation: 体内植入实验对比不同表面涂层效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance osseointegration of Ti implants while mitigating stress shielding through a synergistic approach.
summary_en.method: A hierarchically structured Ti implant with electrically bioactive SnO2-TiO2 bilayered surface was fabricated.
summary_en.result: The combined electric and topographic cues significantly improved osteoblastic function, bone-implant contact, and push-out force.
summary_en.validation: In vivo performance was evaluated by comparing Ti implants with different surfaces, decoupling electric and topographic effects.

papers.title: Biofabrication Strategy for Functional Fabrics.
papers.abstract: Functional fabrics with various unique properties are necessary for making fantastic superior costumes just like a superhero suit in Marvel Comics, which are not only dreams of boys but also emerging textiles to facilitate human life. On the basis of the inspiration of a phenomenon in an extracurricular experiment for kids, we develop a biofabrication strategy to endow silk textiles with various unique physical and chemical properties of functional nanomaterials, where the functional textiles are weaved using silk spun by silkworms that are fed with functional nanomaterials. To confirm the feasibility of this strategy, a photoluminescent plain weave was prepared successfully via feeding biocompatible luminescent nanoparticles to Bombyx mori silkworms. As the functional nanomaterials are enclosed in the silkfibers, the given special properties will be permanent for further application. Considering the wondrous diversity of properties that a variety of nanomaterials possesses may be given to silk fabric, it is promising to see various miraculous costumes in the coming future.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文与利用AI进行生物打印的研究方向无关，仅涉及通过蚕丝生物制造功能纺织品。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve any AI, bioprinting, or computational modeling; it is purely a biofabrication method using silkworms.

summary_zh.motivation: 基于课外实验的灵感，开发一种赋予丝绸纺织品独特性能的生物制造策略。
summary_zh.method: 通过给家蚕喂食功能性纳米材料，使蚕丝具有相应特性，并用于编织功能织物。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了具有光致发光性能的平纹织物，且功能持久。
summary_zh.validation: 通过喂食纳米材料并验证蚕丝的光致发光性能。

summary_en.motivation: Inspired by a kid's experiment, a biofabrication strategy is developed to endow silk textiles with unique properties of functional nanomaterials.
summary_en.method: Functional nanomaterials are fed to silkworms to be incorporated into spun silk, which is then woven into functional fabrics.
summary_en.result: A photoluminescent plain weave was successfully prepared using biocompatible luminescent nanoparticles, showing permanent functional properties.
summary_en.validation: The feasibility was confirmed by preparing and characterizing a photoluminescent silk fabric.
